exposure: Intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine 10 mg with fentanyl 10 μg
Intrathecal bupivacaine 11 mg with fentanyl 10 μg
Intrathecal levobupivacaine 11 mg with fentanyl 10 μg
outcome: Level of absence of cold sensation
Time to achieve sensory block to T4
cohort: 90 ASA I-II parturients undergoing elective cesarean section
finding: While hyperbaric bupivacaine resulted in faster and higher sensory block compared to plain bupivacaine and levobupivacaine, there were no significant differences in terms of effective surgical anesthesia, postoperative analgesia, and side effects among the three groups.
